title: Zombie-directive audit + backfill batch — walk the ~20 pending directives tinker flagged in FND-2 (tinker-2026-07-01), determine per-directive disposition (fulfilled+needs-close / genuinely-pending / superseded), and produce a batch-applicable backfill list. PROP-108 enforce mode is now ON, so backfilling the missing PROP↔directive linkage drains each closeable zombie mechanically on the next tinker run.
context:
Tinker 2026-07-01T02-40 FND-2 MODERATE reported '20 directives remain status=pending; PROP-108 auto-close is shadow-only AND cannot reach most due to missing PROP↔directive linkage.'

Operator has now: (a) shipped PROP-120 (2026-06-30 RC1+RC2 fixes to directive-auto-close.js + backfilled PROP-113/PROP-114 back-refs), and (b) flipped PROP-108 to enforce mode via monitor/decisions/directive-auto-close-enforce.flag (2026-07-01T06:00Z).

What's still missing to drain the zombie backlog: the ~20 pending directives lack either (i) a fulfilling PROP with matching directive_id / source_directive back-ref, OR (ii) the propose-only opt-in flag (auto_close_when_deliverable_proposed) if the deliverable was propose-only.

This directive commissions tinker to walk all pending directives, classify each, and produce a batch-applicable disposition list. The operator will apply the backfills (or approve tinker to apply via mark-directive-superseded.js), and the enforced auto-close mechanism will drain the closeable zombies on the following tinker run.
task: Walk every operator-directive at monitor/tinker/operator-directives/DIRECTIVE-*.json with status='pending'. For each, classify into ONE of: (A) FULFILLED — a PROP exists that resolves this directive but linkage is missing; propose the specific backfill action (add directive_id field on which PROP file, OR add supersedes_directives cross-lineage array on which PROP, OR add auto_close_when_deliverable_proposed:true on the directive itself if the deliverable is a propose-only PROP whose status is already 'proposed'); (B) GENUINELY PENDING — no fulfilling PROP exists yet; leave alone; (C) SUPERSEDED / OBE — the work was overtaken by later PROPs or the intent is no longer relevant; propose status='superseded' with superseded_reason; (D) UNCLEAR — evidence is ambiguous; recommend operator judgment. Produce a single deliverable JSON at monitor/tinker/audits/zombie-directive-audit-2026-07-01.json listing every pending directive with its category + proposed action + evidence.
deliverable_acceptance_criteria: Every pending directive from the walk appears in the audit file exactly once (no dupes, no misses).
Category assignment is evidence-cited: each (A) or (C) case identifies the specific PROP file(s) that fulfilled or superseded the directive, with commit-SHA / date evidence for the resolution moment.

Category (A) actions are batch-applicable: each row includes the specific file path + field to add + value to write, so the operator can apply the batch mechanically (a shell one-liner walking the JSON list is acceptable).
The audit file itself is idempotent: re-running the audit against the same corpus produces the same categorization (deterministic).
Category (D) UNCLEAR rows explicitly say what evidence would resolve them (e.g., 'operator needs to confirm this directive's intent was completed by PROP-XXX not PROP-YYY').
If tinker discovers a pending directive it CANNOT categorize even with best-effort evidence walking, leave it in (D) rather than guessing.
constraints: Propose-only on all backfills. Do NOT apply any directive_id / supersedes_directives / status changes in this run. Operator applies from the audit list.

Exception: if a directive is 100%-verified OBE with unambiguous evidence AND its fulfilling PROP already exists AND that PROP has matching content, tinker MAY additively edit the directive to status='completed' per the CLAUDE.md DIRECTIVE-LIFECYCLE exception. Any such auto-flips MUST be listed in the audit with 'auto_applied_by_this_run: true' and full evidence citation for operator retro-verification.
Do NOT open new PROPs. This audit is a categorization exercise, not new-work generation.
Do NOT re-review the propose-only chain we shipped this week (DIRECTIVE-20260628-002 → 005 already have opt-in) — those are correctly linked. Skip them.
Keep the audit tight — evidence should be 1-3 lines per directive, not narrative walls.

backfill_tools_already_available: Direct JSON edit to PROP-XXX.json adding directive_id field (RC2 pattern used for PROP-113/114 2026-06-30)
background_artifacts.affected_directive_count_estimate: ~20 pending directives (from tinker FND-2 count); actual audit may vary as tinker will find edge cases the count missed.
background_artifacts.operator_workflow: After tinker delivers the audit: operator reads the (A) FULFILLED batch, applies backfills via shell one-liner or manual edits, commits, pushes. Next tinker run's directive-auto-close.js pass sees the newly-linked directives and closes them mechanically (enforce mode). Any (C) SUPERSEDED cases the operator applies directly. (D) UNCLEAR cases sit for follow-up.

not_in_scope: Applying the backfills in this tinker run (propose-only unless 100%-verified OBE).
Reviewing PROPs that don't have a linked pending directive.
Auditing the closed-issues.json / closure-ledger.jsonl for zombie ISSs (separate concern; not this scope).
Modifying directive-auto-close.js or the enforce mechanism itself.
Cataloging PROPs that are wrongly-marked 'implemented' (that's the DIRECTIVE-20260628-004 Candidate A scope; overlaps but is separate).
